title: Montréal Self-Guided City Walking Tour & Scavenger Hunt
includes: Free download of the Explorial App from your appstore (iOS or Android smartphone required)
Points and scoring system: Compete between players of your group and beat the cities high score.
Live Location: navigate within the map with marked locations. Always know where you are.
Learn about the cities stories, history, and local legends
Total flexibility: no waiting, start anytime, walk at own pace and do as many breaks as you want.
Self-guided walking tour with interactive riddles, trivia challenges and photo tasks.
Live-Guide: 100% self-guided; no one will meet you or join your group. Start anytime you want (not included)
Entrance fees are not required for this game. All puzzles relate to the public areas of the sights (not included)
This is not an audio guide but an sightseeing, gaming and learning experience (not included)
requirements: Suitable for all physical fitness levels
Max 15 people per booking. For larger groups, make multiple bookings.
policies: After booking you receive a text message and a Viator message with your game code. Download the Explorial app from your appstore. Open the app, enter your 6 digit game code
Weather & Health Guarantee: If bad weather or illness prevents you from starting the tour, you can simply reschedule it for another day. You can also rebook to a different city or request a refund

Smartphone required: Bring your own fully charged smartphone with an active mobile data connection to the start of the tour. Please disable any VPN and avoid city Wi-Fi, as these will cause the app to malfunction or disconnect.
Recommended attire: It’s best to wear weather-appropriate clothing and comfortable walking shoes — approx. 2 hours of light walking
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
Old Montréal stacks New France, Victorian silver domes and a Ferris wheel into one riverside quarter — game on.

This app-led scavenger hunt takes you through Montréal on foot, using phone-based riddles to guide you from one landmark to the next. No guide, no fixed start time.

• Climb to Place Vauquelin and its fountain between city hall and the courts
• Browse the silver-domed Marché Bonsecours, once Canada's parliament
• Spot La Grande Roue de Montréal turning over the Old Port

Available in 24 languages including English, French, German, Spanish, Italian — see the full list when booking and choose yours when you start the game in the app.
Around 2 hours - any group size.

Vieux-Montréal, nouveau jeu.
